==Description==
'''v1.10.0''' is the sixty-second update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 16th of December 2023.

This update was also given the name '''Quests Update''', as this update added the [[Quests]].

This version encompasses two updates, the main v1.10.0 (released 16 December 2023) and one minor update, the v1.10.0a (released 16 December 2023)

==Additions==
*[[Quests]]

==Changes & Bugfixes==
*Maps are now streamed when joining a match.
**Reduces server memory usage and load times.

: In '''v1.10.0a'''
*[[Quests]] changed.
**Reduced difficulty.
**Increased rewards for some [[Quests]].
**[[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can no longer appear in '''Damage with ''TOWER''''' quests.

==Official Update Log==

===v1.10.0===
{{UpdateLog|
{{UpdateBanner|LobbyRender1.png|📜 Quests Update 📜}}
{{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}}
{{UpdateH3|🎆[[Quests]]!🎆}}
*Dailies refresh every 24 hours!
*Weeklies refresh every 7 days!
*Dailies generate 4 quests to pick from!
*Weeklies generate 1 quest to pick from!
*12 unique [[Quests|quest]] types!
*Added a [[Quests|quest]] refill for those who want to chage their [[quests]]!
*More will be added in the future!
*⚠️This feature is still in beta!⚠️
{{UpdateH3|🗺️Map Streaming}}
*All [[Maps|maps]] are now streamed in when you play a match!
*Should help with the loading times!
*Server memory usage has been reduced
{{UpdateH3|🎄Holiday Event}}
*The Holiday Event will be coming sometime this month!
*Stay up to date on our socials for more info!
*...before Christmas prehaps?🎅
}}
